Less matchday  guesswork.  Your first racket match on SportStage, step by step.
Which sport  today?  Tap Start a match and choose your sport.
Who’s playing?  Know the format.  Pick the players and first server, then review the match rules.
Ready when  you are.  Tap Start match, then tap a score card to record each rally.
Wrong tap?  Undo it.  Tap Undo to remove the latest rally from the score.
Your next match.  Your stage.  Save the playbook. Share it with your scorekeeper.
